Introduce a distinct run-outcome error for an operation failure versus failure to record that failure; the compound variant owns the original structured error and the diagnostic-write cause. This is not a duplicate operation error.

Give failure-report locking, JSON encoding and file output structured owning error variants. FailureRecorder consumes CoreLoopError directly and retains its fallback source; remove the intermediate to_string handoff.

Adapt the single existing recorder fixture without new cases/assertions. Add its existing failure-security suite as a required hosted test group and preserve the earlier 40 groups/16 Creator command vectors.
Keep current schema-v9 failure projection/redaction and chronological/bootstrap behavior; do not move threat construction before database work merely to avoid propagating its error.
Source-review all public/native/root callers and test paths, preserve source metadata, then publish for hosted checks.
